sloka: वीरं शतवलिं चैव मैन्दं द्विविदमेव च ।गजं गवाक्षं गवयं शरभं च महाबलम् ।पश्य प्रीतिसमायुक्तो गन्धमादनमेव च ।। ७.४०.५ ॥
transliteration: vīraṁ śatavaliṁ caiva maindaṁ dvividameva ca ।gajaṁ gavākṣaṁ gavayaṁ śarabhaṁ ca mahābalam ।paśya prītisamāyukto gandhamādanameva ca ।। 7.40.5 ॥

translations.english: Look with affection upon the brave Shatavali, Mainda, Dvivida, Gaja, Gavaksha, Gavaya, Sharabha of great strength, and Gandhamadana.
